notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44736783/9affda568217764377cb1509dda3803c20b7bfa6.png[/img]
[b]BoneField is Officially Joining Forces with Indie.io![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that BoneField has partnered with Indie.io to help bring the game to even more players! For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like Indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From managing store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and ensuring the game shines at both digital and live events, Indie.io is here to help in all the areas indie developers often struggle with alone.

At its core, BoneField is a project built from our passion for crafting intense, tactical, bodycam-style horror experiences. With each step of development, we've aimed to create a haunting world that keeps players on edge, and we couldn’t be more excited to see where this partnership with Indie.io will take us.

We decided to team up with Indie.io because of their incredible track record in helping other indie games reach a wider audience. They’ve been instrumental in launching numerous successful titles, and we’re confident they are the right partner to help BoneField achieve its full potential.

Check out some other amazing games by Indie.io, and don’t forget to wishlist BoneField on Steam!

notes.title: Bonefield Demo 4.0 Update
notes.content:
We are thrilled to present the Bonefield Demo 4.0 Update, an immersive dive into horror gaming like never before. In this update, we’ve intensified the spine-chilling experience, addressed bugs, and enhanced gameplay mechanics to ensure you're fully immersed in the sinister world of Bonefield. Here’s what to expect:

**New Features and Enhancements:**

1. **Extended Gameplay:** Now experience the first fifteen minutes of Bonefield's gripping story and gameplay combined. Dive deeper into the unsettling narrative as you uncover the dark secrets lurking within Bonefield.

2. **Enhanced Graphics:** Immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere with improved graphics, lighting effects, and detailed environments. Every shadow, every creaking floorboard, and every flicker of light will keep you on edge as you navigate the sinister corridors of Bonefield.

3. **Terrifying Sound Design:** Feel the dread intensify with our revamped sound design. From eerie whispers to bone-chilling screams, every sound will send shivers down your spine, adding an extra layer of horror to your gameplay experience.

4. **Updated Controls:** We’ve fine-tuned the controls for smoother navigation through Bonefield’s treacherous terrain. Whether you're creeping through dimly lit corridors or fleeing from unspeakable horrors, you'll have better control over every movement.

**Bug Fixes and Optimization:**

1. **Fixed Game-breaking Bugs:** Say goodbye to frustrating game crashes and progression-halting bugs. We've squashed numerous pesky bugs to ensure a seamless and uninterrupted gaming experience.

2. **Improved Performance:** Enjoy smoother gameplay with optimized performance across all platforms. Bonefield will deliver a consistently terrifying experience without any lag or slowdowns.

**Experience Bonefield Like Never Before:**

Prepare to be engulfed in fear as you embark on a journey into the heart of darkness with Bonefield Demo 4.0 Update. Explore the desolate house, unravel the mysteries, and confront the horrors that await you in the shadows. Are you brave enough to survive the terror that lurks within Bonefield? Only time will tell...

notes.title: Demo "Story" Update + Bug fixes
notes.content:
**Bonefield: Demo Update - Story and Gameplay Enhancement**

We're thrilled to announce a major update to the Bonefield demo, featuring an immersive blend of story progression, gameplay enhancements, bug fixes, and a revamped menu system. In this update, players will dive deeper into the chilling narrative as they step into the shoes of Brandon Gray, an undercover officer searching for his missing brother amidst the eerie confines of Bonefield.

**Story Expansion:**

Experience the first fifteen minutes of Bonefield's gripping narrative as Brandon Gray. Unravel the mystery surrounding his brother's disappearance while navigating through the dark and foreboding atmosphere of Bonefield. Encounter sinister forces and uncover twisted secrets that lurk within the shadows.

**Menu Revamp:**

- **Streamlined Interface:** Navigate through the game's menus with ease thanks to a revamped interface that prioritizes user experience and accessibility.
- **Visual Overhaul:** Enjoy a fresh new look for the menu system, featuring updated visuals and intuitive design elements.
- **Improved Functionality:** Access key features and options more efficiently, allowing for a smoother and more immersive gaming experience.

**Bug Fixes:**

- **Stability Improvements:** Addressed various stability issues and performance optimizations to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
- **Bug Squashing:** Fixed numerous bugs and glitches reported by players, enhancing overall game stability and polish.

**Get ready to immerse yourself in Bonefield's chilling world, where the line between reality and nightmare blurs with every step. Download the demo update now and uncover the dark secrets that lie within.**

notes.title: Day 1 Demo 3.1 Patch
notes.content:
**Bonefield Day 1 Demo 3.1 Patch Update Notes:**

Dear Bonefield Day 1 Demo Players,

We're excited to bring you the latest update, Patch 3.1, addressing several issues and implementing some enhancements to improve your gaming experience. Here's what's included in this patch:

**Bug Fixes:**

1. **Fixed Flashlight Position:** We've resolved the issue with the flashlight position, ensuring it now functions correctly without any awkward positioning or glitches.

2. **Menu Bug Patched:** The buggy menu that was causing inconvenience to players has been thoroughly patched. You should now experience smoother navigation and functionality within the menu interface.

**Enhancements:**

1. **Clearer Beginning Tutorial:** We've revamped the beginning tutorial to provide clearer instructions and guidance for new players. Whether you're new to Bonefield Day 1 or a returning player, this updated tutorial will ensure you start your journey with confidence and clarity.

We hope these improvements enhance your overall gameplay experience in Bonefield Day 1 Demo. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please continue to share your thoughts and suggestions as we strive to make Bonefield Day 1 the best it can be.

Thank you for your continued support and dedication to exploring the mysteries of Bonefield!

Happy Gaming!

[RedRockGS]
